configurePresets.name: core-only-base
configurePresets.description: Platform-independent subset: no io_uring transport. Required on non-Linux hosts.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised build with assertions and debug info; the default development preset.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised build without the production hardening flags. Use 'production' for deployment.

configurePresets.name: production
configurePresets.description: The preset a deployable artefact must be built with. RelWithDebInfo (optimised, but with debug info retained so a core dump from production is analysable), tests off, and the exploit-mitigation flag set documented in docs/deployment.md 'Build hardening'.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: ASan and UBSan together (they are compatible and share a runtime).

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: TSan. Mutually exclusive with ASan; the two runtimes cannot be combined.

configurePresets.name: ubsan
configurePresets.description: UBSan without ASan. Much cheaper than the asan preset, so it can run over the whole suite on every commit; also isolates UBSan findings from ASan's.

configurePresets.name: asan-core-only
configurePresets.description: ASan/UBSan on the platform-independent subset. This is the sanitizer preset that runs on non-Linux development hosts, where the io_uring transport cannot be compiled at all.

configurePresets.name: tsan-core-only
configurePresets.description: TSan on the platform-independent subset. Covers the genuinely concurrent core components (AsyncFileSink writer thread, LiveFanout, SegmentStore, StreamRegistry, RtmpAuthenticator, HTTP server); the io_uring worker pool needs a Linux host.

configurePresets.name: fuzz
configurePresets.description: Coverage-guided fuzzing with libFuzzer + ASan. Requires Clang with compiler-rt's libFuzzer, which Apple Clang does not ship - on macOS use the standalone driver instead (fuzz/fuzz_main.hpp, --runs N).
